items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: Norman, who, Norman Simmons booked a drummer who is a student at William Paterson College.

ctx.x: Where do they develop their skills?

We had a, I don’t know if Joe told you this, but he was working in Washington, DC last week and they didn’t have a drummer. Norman, who, Norman Simmons booked a drummer who is a student at William Paterson College. Did they tell you this? And his name is Paul Wells. And Norman thought he showed great promise and so he booked him for this job. And Paul had to take finals during the week of the gig. So he said I can’t miss this opportunity, so he went to his principal and said, “I have a chance to work for a week…
